metadata.description: s2ar's tools for Claude Code: sym (read the function, not the file), lens (the screenshot, not the pixels) and s2ar (the hosted tools: assert, inspect, score, certify, sym over any public repo)

plugins.name: sym
plugins.description: Symbol-level code reads for coding agents (CLI + MCP + a Read hook). Keeps whole files out of context.

plugins.name: lens
plugins.description: lens: the screenshot, not the pixels. A whole-image Read over 1024 px comes back downscaled to the size a model reads, with the tokens kept out on the line.

plugins.name: s2ar
plugins.description: s2ar: the hosted tools as MCP tools — assert an output against a schema and a source (a signed record), inspect an x402 endpoint before paying it, grade a text, certify an image, read code from any public repo. Free samples first; a $5 key or USDC per call after. Hooks only remind.
